"""Main moves the completed report to its canonical private research directory."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
F = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/docs-sycl-storage-retention-20261009/bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression')
NAME = 'research-integrated-full262144-runtime-consumer-gap-round242-v1.txt'
EXPECTED = '1b41ff0dbe3f925290369c9aa00c08920fa05125babae2443d4b53ee92146e1e'

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    summary = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v6/campaign-summary.json').read_text())
    assert summary['passed'] and summary['complete'] and not summary['active']
    source = F / 'research' / NAME
    target = B / 'research-20261009' / NAME
    assert source.is_file() and not target.exists()
    data = source.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == EXPECTED
    target.write_bytes(data)
    assert target.read_bytes() == data
    receipt = B / 'latest-update-main-r242-canonicalization-v1.json'
    assert not receipt.exists()
    manifest = dict(passed=False, source=str(source), target=str(target), sha256=EXPECTED,
                    bytes=len(data), original_report_unchanged=True,
                    reason='Completed researcher wrote to worktree; canonicalize outside Git before Main publication',
                    owner='/root', model_campaign_closed=True)
    receipt.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
    source.unlink()
    manifest['passed'] = True
    receipt.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(manifest))
